structures.desc: 3 route slots.

pieces.name: Larder
pieces.desc: +300 food capacity, +5% XP from better meals

pieces.name: Forge
pieces.desc: Smelts 3 iron ore → 1 iron ingot (2/day) and 2 copper ore → 1 copper ingot (3/day); +1 crafting spot

pieces.name: Herb Rack
pieces.desc: Brews 3 thyme → 1 potion, 2/day; 2 herb spots. Potions auto-heal injuries

pieces.name: Tool Rack
pieces.desc: Resource-gathering spot: 2 gathering + 1 herb minion spots

pieces.name: Market Stall
pieces.desc: 1 merchant spot: sells your 'stock for sale' at full price over time

pieces.name: Ore Cart
pieces.desc: 2 mining spots: followers dig iron and copper ore

pieces.name: Steel Anvil
pieces.desc: +12% craft quality, 2 crafting spots, +3% craft XP (Crafters' Guild rank 2)

pieces.name: Alchemist's Bench
pieces.desc: Thyme → potions; mandrake → sleep/poison draughts; moonpetal → arcane dust or mana tonic (Magic guild rank 2)

pieces.name: Mason's Table
pieces.desc: Cuts 3 stone → 1 block, 3/day (Masonry speeds it up)

pieces.name: Shaft Lift
pieces.desc: Raises 1.5 iron + 1.5 copper ore + 0.5 salt/day; 2 mining spots

pieces.name: Garden Beds
pieces.desc: Grows 2.5 thyme, 3 provisions, 1.5 vegetables, some sage/mandrake/flax; 1 herb + 1 farming spot

pieces.name: Game Rack
pieces.desc: Brings in 2 meat + 0.8 hides/day; 2 hunting spots

pieces.name: Remedy Bench
pieces.desc: Thyme → remedies/potions; sage + honey → healing salve; sage → strong remedy; mandrake + sage → sleep draught

pieces.name: Arcane Focus
pieces.desc: 1 arcane dust/day, +5% Magic XP; scroll crafting station

pieces.name: Altar
pieces.desc: Faster healing, +0.3 follower loyalty/day, +5% family XP (blessing)

pieces.name: Quest Board
pieces.desc: Rumors cost half; adventuring followers share tips (+10%)

pieces.name: Training Pells
pieces.desc: Posts and straw dummies: unlocks Spar at the Pells and Loose at the Butts

pieces.name: Hourglass
pieces.desc: +5% game tick speed; unlocks Count the Sands

pieces.name: Grandfather Clock
pieces.desc: +10% game tick speed; unlocks Tend the Clockwork

pieces.name: Headstones
pieces.desc: Rest for the dead: banks their renown as Legacy Renown

pieces.name: Bread Oven
pieces.desc: Bakes bread (flour, or flour + eggs) and berry pies (flour + berries + butter)

pieces.name: Smoke Rack
pieces.desc: Meat or fish + salt → smoked provisions

pieces.name: Cooking Hearth
pieces.desc: Starter kitchen: porridge (barley + milk, or plain wheat) and stew (meat + vegetables + thyme)

pieces.name: Furrowed Fields
pieces.desc: 3 wheat, 1.5 barley, 2 vegetables, 0.8 flax/day (seasonal); 2 farming spots

pieces.name: Kitchen Range
pieces.desc: Big stew pot and porridge kettle; +5% meal XP

pieces.name: Brewing Vats
pieces.desc: 3 barley → 1 ale, 2/day. Ale on the menu lifts morale

pieces.name: Enchanter's Table
pieces.desc: Workshop enchanting + crafting station; the Arcane Workshop's upgrades add quality, speed and enchant slots.

pieces.name: Rune Desk
pieces.desc: Personal enchanting nook: 1 job, first enchant slot only, slower. The Arcane Workshop does it better.

pieces.name: Reagent Shelf
pieces.desc: Pairs with a Rune Desk or Enchanter's Table in the same building: better and faster enchanting.

pieces.name: Glyph Lectern
pieces.desc: Mage-made: pairs with a Rune Desk or Enchanter's Table (better, faster enchanting)

pieces.name: Stable Stalls
pieces.desc: Stalls and a feed trough for 2 draft animals

classHousingNote: Class buildings house followers of matching NPC classes like a Bunkhouse (cap 2, +1 per upgrade); residents get +15% output.
